result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`. I ran the existing `cli` module tests and they pass, but I didn't add a test or run either command by hand. So I haven't confirmed that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` produces `config.json` and `index.html`, or what `analyzeLandscape -help` prints.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` just before `updateLandscape`, with the same options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: Both names go to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so options and behaviour are identical. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: The README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering `init`, `generateReports`, `updateConfig`, `analyzeLandscape` and `updateLandscape`. The new section follows the Docker "Run init command" line directly, with no blank line before its heading.
